content.title: Pepperl+Fuchs 411-2561 Pressure Sensor, IP65
content.short_description: Pepperl+Fuchs 411-2561 is a pressure sensor rated IP65 for ingress protection, suited for industrial monitoring applications.
content.long_description:
The Pepperl+Fuchs 411-2561 is a pressure sensor designed for use in industrial instrumentation systems where process pressure monitoring is required. It carries an IP65 ingress protection rating, indicating protection against dust ingress and low-pressure water jets from any direction, making it suitable for installation in environments exposed to dust and occasional washdown or splash conditions.

As part of the Sensors & Transmitters category, the 411-2561 is intended for integration into instrumentation and control systems requiring reliable pressure sensing. Specific electrical, mechanical, and output signal specifications should be confirmed against the manufacturer datasheet prior to installation to ensure compatibility with the intended process and control architecture.

Procurement and maintenance teams should reference the MPN 411-2561 when sourcing replacement units or verifying part compatibility with existing Pepperl+Fuchs sensor installations.
bullets: Suitable for industrial environments with dust and splash exposure
